organization.discoveryNotes: Aviation operating model: station/service operations, passenger service, maintenance coordination, safety, procurement, and shift-aware SAREA dashboards. Staging/demo validated — not a production customer claim.

workflows.name: Service request intake
workflows.description: Passenger or customer service request logged and routed to the right team.

workflows.name: Passenger / customer issue escalation
workflows.description: Escalation from frontline agent to supervisor and operations when needed.

workflows.name: Ground operation task assignment
workflows.description: Ground tasks assigned to stations with shift handover notes.

workflows.name: Maintenance request review
workflows.description: Maintenance coordination request reviewed with safety awareness.

workflows.name: Supplier request
workflows.description: Procurement request with finance and operations approval paths.

workflows.name: Safety incident report
workflows.description: Safety incident captured with evidence readiness and closure tracking.

workflows.name: Quality / service review
workflows.description: Service quality review with corrective action follow-up.

workflows.name: Workforce / shift request
workflows.description: Shift or staffing change request coordinated through HR.

workflows.name: Access / role review
workflows.description: Periodic review of station-scoped roles and privileged access.

workflows.name: Finance / billing review
workflows.description: Billing and cost coordination review for aviation services.

workflows.name: Monthly aviation operations report
workflows.description: Monthly operations summary for executive and analyst review.

workflows.name: CyberCrow incident review
workflows.description: Security incident review with evidence trail for operator posture.

securityRequirements.requirement: Station-scoped RBAC for ground, passenger service, and maintenance roles
Audit trail on service escalations and supplier approvals
Privileged access monitoring for operations and tenant admin (advisory)
Evidence readiness for safety incidents — not regulatory certification

integrations.notes: Corporate SSO for stations and service centers

experienceRequirements.requirement: Operations health, safety open items, service risk posture
Operations control board with service tasks and exceptions
Passenger service agent intake and follow-up workspace
Reporting readiness and monthly operations summary
CyberCrow console for access review and incident evidence

identity.ssoNotes: Aviation template: MFA recommended for operations, procurement, finance, and tenant admin roles.

security.complianceNotes: Safety and service workflows require evidence retention; segment station vs service-center access. Readiness notes only.
